input.title: Lemon Olive Oil Cake
input.description: A moist, fragrant cake that keeps for days.

steps.standardize:
By Rosa Bellini · Prep 15 min · Bake 45 min

Ingredients

  • 3 eggs
  • 200 g sugar
  • 120 ml olive oil
  • zest of 2 lemons
  • 220 g flour

Method

  1. Whisk eggs and sugar until pale.
  2. Fold in oil, zest and flour.
  3. Bake at 170°C for 45 minutes.

Tip: the cake tastes better the next day.
